book.title: Matiyu Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Matiyuyaŋ meluwaŋ mge

content: Zisasiyaŋ gakikiengatnaŋ wage
Âpme Sabat tagoŋgo kan delaŋ zeme mseŋan Sonda tambuŋan msat tapmsame msame Malia Makdala mkaengatnaŋmak Malia ŋen kemak Zisasiyelen sum eksât mebun.
Âpme Amobotnaŋgalen ensel ŋenaŋ kululuŋengatnaŋ kwatoge keyepm mâkinaŋ temaŋ memendepmak mge. Ensel keyaŋ kwatoti sumen ke meti nanzaŋ sekekek mâtâpemti keyet dukŋan totapmaŋge.
Ensel ek sepemaŋ ambeyak nemboŋ ma sâk miayakŋaŋ satnaŋ leŋganaŋ penaŋ.
Âpme kasa kuku damuŋ tabien ekŋenaŋ egat kiŋgagat omba mti selin belin omba wendime katik katik sim gakikiŋaŋnok msalen tokutumti wembien.
Kegok mme enselaŋ imbi egegat pigok zeye, “It kiŋgagapiŋ. Ke neŋ nâyap, it Zisas tewen kukuŋaŋ egat tatimalup.
Ek kapi ku tazin. Ek itnaŋaŋ zeyenok belakzem walep. Pien koti mundumaŋ bewienen egit.
It sakwep kapiyak meti nemuŋane pigok diindoseip, ‘Eklak gakikiengatnaŋ walep. Mti egaŋ ŋeŋaŋ bemindemti Galili msalen alak mezin in ke meti ekseip!’ In neŋ zet diindowan ke nâit!”
Kegok mti egelaŋ kiŋgagat ma oloŋen temakwep nâmti sum sakwep katikpemti nembaŋane ningat zapat dinndosât winde bembeŋak mebun.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ eget memendepmak idaikti diidoye, “Tambuŋan penaŋ, keŋ sewakŋaŋ itmak tasem.” Zeme egelaŋ ekmagen koti setnaŋ ambepumti sesewatsawun.
Kegok mmalut Zisasiyaŋ egegat diidoye, “It ku kiŋgalit. It meti nembanne ekŋengat zemalut ekŋenaŋ Galili daen meti ke menaikbep.”
Kasa kuku ekŋenaŋ damuŋ tabien keyet zapat mbien

Âpme imbi egelaŋ selen tapmepmalu an kasa kuku sum damuŋ tabien ekŋenmagengatnaŋ notnaŋaŋ gilik zemti Zelusalem mka teman meti sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe sokbeye keyet zapatnaŋ mbien.
Zapat ke mme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ nâmti sesewat mka temaŋgalen an damuŋ ekŋenmak ondekti zet zemtâmpewien. Kegok mti kasa kuku ekŋen mânep makukuŋaŋ temaŋ penaŋ indamti
pigok zewien, “In am pigok diindoseip, ‘Nin meluk tawemann nembaŋaneyaŋ tambuyet koti Zisasiyet sekŋaŋ kambu mmelo.’
Âk Loma ekŋengalen amobotnaŋaŋ zapat kapi nâsem beme nin ŋep zemann nâsem. Âpme in keyet yayaŋ ku mseip.”
Kegok zeme kasa kuku ekŋenaŋ nâme ŋep beme mânewin timti zemâtâtindawienok zemebien. Kok keyepmti zapat kapiyaŋ Zuda am ekŋenmagen palakŋaŋ beyeyaŋ pigogat ewe tazin.
Zisasiyaŋ nemuŋanemagen sokbemindaye
Âpme nembaŋane 11 nin Galili msalen meti kalaŋ ŋen Zisasiyaŋ ikŋaŋ zemâtâtndaye ke mebenn.
Meti ikŋaŋ aikbenn ya nembaŋaneyaŋ nin dundum sawennaŋgut notnaŋaŋ egaŋ gakikiengatnaŋ wage keyet keŋ zut mbien.
Mme Zisasiyaŋ sokŋan koti zeye, “Winde sambe kululuŋ keŋan ma msat palen Kawawaŋaŋ neŋ name delaŋ zenzeŋaŋ.
Keyepmti in msat kataŋ meti am sambe Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ zikat indame nâgât nâmkiŋpeme Kawawaŋ Bipm ma nâgât kwitnnan ma Emetak Teŋ ningat kwitnnan tu zulutindewep.
Mti neŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe zemâtâtindawan ke gawepupuyelen kegok zikat indawep. Âpme neŋ zema nâit, neŋ kan kataŋ inmak kwesiŋ kwesiŋ mamti tapmanepema kan delaŋ zenzeŋaŋ bewe.”
